row.asStated: n=3 cold-run median; prompt std-pp512-v1; decode 128 tok; Marked failed 2026-10-17. With llama.rn 0.12.4 (locked in our harness when this row was measured), llama.cpp Hexagon output on this phone is wrong for every tested prompt longer than ~128 tokens; this row used a ~512-token prompt and has no output check, so its speed does not represent correct inference. With llama.rn 0.13.0-rc.7 the Llama 3.2 1B output is correct (Q4_K_M passes; Q4_0 passes the same probes as its CPU reference, gate unverified). Successor: a separate Q4_K_M row, not yet measured.
